svg.aria-label: Symlink resolution across check and scan
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Symlink resolution across check and scan
svg.desc: The new symlink module sits between the check dispatcher and the filesystem, and the scan walker now calls into it instead of skipping links.
